items.followUp: Define hypothesis in the biological method.

rubric.why: A deduction is the logical consequence or conclusion drawn from a hypothesis.
rubric.description: Defines a deduction as a logical consequence or conclusion of a hypothesis.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking a logical consequence or conclusion to a hypothesis.

rubric.why: Deductions are commonly expressed as predictions based on the hypothesis.
rubric.description: States that a deduction is expressed as a prediction.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying a prediction as the form or use of a deduction.

modelAnswer: A deduction is a logical consequence of a hypothesis.
It is usually expressed as a prediction of what should happen if the hypothesis is correct.
